color_story: Cool spring mint (H:160°, full saturation) as the single dominant accent carries interactive presence: links, nav focus, alert rings, the moon percentage. Warm amber (H:35°, 120° away) appears only in emotional signals—Tigers badge, Dickens border, lunar illumination label—earning attention through rarity and warmth contrast alone. Sage-grey neutrals (H:160°, S:5-8%) preserve crystalline clarity across the 13.7-hour May daylight without flattening. The waning gibbous moon (94.5%) drives tonal architecture: near-black Awwwards room cards burst against pale, nearly-white panels, creating sharp chiaroscuro and hard micro-shadows that echo the moon's drama. Spacing scale (4px base) honors Sunday's dual nature—generous panels (32-64px) permit leisurely browsing while tight rhythms (4-8px) signal craft precision. One hue anchors the system; one warm accent punctuates emotion; breathing room welcomes discovery; high tonal contrast creates visual presence without saturation.
